nextLevel.how: inferred: the Next Level block is Effective Level + 1 with Base Level unchanged. Only that reproduces the shown next-level poison (Base Level 26 would give 2625-3571), and Poison Pierce (a Base Level formula) is not listed under Next Level because it does not change.
